subScenes.name: 咨询验光
subScenes.description: 顾客询问是否需要验光及验光流程。

qaPairs.triggerText: What seems to be the problem with your vision?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 验光咨询：服务员询问视力问题

followUps.text: I can't see distant objects clearly, especially while driving.
followUps.text_cn: 我看不清远处的东西，尤其是开车时。

followUps.text: My eyes get tired quickly when reading, and words sometimes blur.
followUps.text_cn: 阅读时眼睛容易疲劳，字有时会模糊。

followUps.text: I'm not sure—I just feel my glasses aren't working well anymore.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，只是觉得现在的眼镜不太管用了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于验光初诊阶段，顾客描述视力困扰，服务员据此推荐检查项目

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you wear contacts or just glasses?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您平时戴隐形眼镜还是框架眼镜？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 验光咨询：服务员确认佩戴习惯

followUps.text: I only wear glasses—I find contacts uncomfortable.
followUps.text_cn: 我只戴框架眼镜，觉得隐形眼镜不舒服。

followUps.text: I wear contacts most days, but switch to glasses for sports.
followUps.text_cn: 我平时戴隐形，但运动时换框架眼镜。

followUps.text: I've never worn contacts—can you tell me if I'm a good candidate?
followUps.text_cn: 我从来没戴过隐形眼镜，您能告诉我我适合吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于判断顾客佩戴习惯，决定验光重点或推荐镜片类型

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like to try some frames before we order?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 在下单前，您想试戴几副镜框吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 验光咨询：服务员建议试戴镜框

followUps.text: Yes, please—I want to see how they look with my face shape.
followUps.text_cn: 好的，请给我试试，我想看看哪种适合我的脸型。

followUps.text: No, I'm good—I already know what style I want.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，我已经知道想要什么款式了。

followUps.text: Can I take a few home to show my partner? I'll decide tomorrow.
followUps.text_cn: 我能带几副回家给伴侣看看吗？我明天再决定。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于选镜框环节，顾客表达不同决策风格，服务员需灵活应对

subScenes.name: 挑选镜框
subScenes.description: 顾客试戴不同材质镜框并咨询舒适度与风格。

qaPairs.triggerText: Which frame style are you leaning toward?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您倾向于哪种镜框款式？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 眼镜店配镜 - 挑选镜框

followUps.text: I like these slim metal ones—they look professional.
followUps.text_cn: 我喜欢这些细金属框的，看起来很专业。

followUps.text: I'm not sure—I like the tortoiseshell but worry they're too big.
followUps.text_cn: 我不确定，我喜欢玳瑁色的，但担心太大了。

followUps.text: Can you show me something more colorful? I want to stand out.
followUps.text_cn: 能给我看看颜色更鲜艳一点的吗？我想突出个性。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客在试戴后表达偏好或犹豫时，服务员引导决策的自然对话场景。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you prefer lightweight frames or don't mind a bit of weight for durability?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您更喜欢轻便的镜框，还是可以接受稍重一点但更耐用的？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 眼镜店配镜 - 挑选镜框

followUps.text: Lightweight is a must—I wear glasses all day.
followUps.text_cn: 必须轻便，我整天都戴眼镜。

followUps.text: I'd rather have something sturdy—I break glasses easily.
followUps.text_cn: 我宁愿选结实一点的，我容易弄坏眼镜。

followUps.text: Does it matter? I just want them to look good.
followUps.text_cn: 这有关系吗？我只在乎看起来好不好看。

qaPairs.usageNote: 服务员询问材质偏好，用户根据使用习惯或审美给出不同优先级回应。

qaPairs.triggerText: Are you looking for something classic or more trendy?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您是想要经典款，还是更时尚潮流的款式？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 眼镜店配镜 - 挑选镜框

followUps.text: Classic, please—I don’t want to replace them every year.
followUps.text_cn: 请给我经典款，我不想每年都换新眼镜。

followUps.text: Trendy! I want to match my outfit this season.
followUps.text_cn: 要潮流款！我想和我这季的穿搭搭配。

followUps.text: Actually, I’m open—just show me what’s popular right now.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我都行，给我看看现在最流行的款式吧。

qaPairs.usageNote: 店员通过风格定位帮助顾客缩小选择范围，用户回应体现消费心理差异。

subScenes.name: 选择镜片
subScenes.description: 顾客了解防蓝光、防反射等镜片功能并做选择。

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like standard, anti-reflective, or blue light blocking lenses?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您想要普通镜片、防反射镜片还是防蓝光镜片？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 眼镜店配镜：选择镜片类型

followUps.text: I'll go with anti-reflective, please. I work on screens all day.
followUps.text_cn: 我要防反射镜片，我整天对着屏幕。

followUps.text: What's the difference between blue light and anti-reflective? I'm not sure.
followUps.text_cn: 防蓝光和防反射有什么区别？我不太确定。

followUps.text: Just the standard ones, thanks. I don't need extra features.
followUps.text_cn: 普通镜片就行，谢谢，我不需要额外功能。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客在专业建议下做出镜片选择，体现不同消费态度和需求层次

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you want single vision or progressive lenses?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您需要单光镜片还是渐进镜片？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 眼镜店配镜：选择镜片设计（单光/渐进）

followUps.text: Progressive, please. I need to see both far and close up.
followUps.text_cn: 我要渐进镜片，我需要看清远近两个距离。

followUps.text: Single vision is fine. I only need help with distance.
followUps.text_cn: 单光就行，我只需要矫正远视。

followUps.text: I’ve never worn progressives. Are they hard to get used to?
followUps.text_cn: 我从没戴过渐进镜片，适应起来难吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 针对不同视力需求（如老花、单纯远视）和使用经验设计的典型回应

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like scratch-resistant or UV-protective coating?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您需要加防刮涂层还是防紫外线涂层？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 眼镜店配镜：选择镜片附加涂层

followUps.text: Both, please. I’m outside a lot and I’m clumsy with my glasses.
followUps.text_cn: 两个都要，我经常在户外，而且戴眼镜容易刮花。

followUps.text: Just UV protection. I don’t mind if they scratch a little.
followUps.text_cn: 只要防紫外线就行，刮花我无所谓。

followUps.text: Is there an extra cost for these? I’m on a tight budget.
followUps.text_cn: 这些涂层要加钱吗？我预算比较紧。

qaPairs.usageNote: 反映顾客在附加功能与预算之间的权衡，是服务场景中高频决策点

subScenes.name: 确认价格
subScenes.description: 顾客询问总价、优惠及付款方式。

qaPairs.triggerText: The total comes to $245, including the frames and lenses. How would you like to pay?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 镜框和镜片总共是245美元，您想怎么支付？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 确认价格后支付方式选择

followUps.text: I'll pay by credit card.
followUps.text_cn: 我用信用卡支付。

followUps.text: Do you accept cash? I only have cash today.
followUps.text_cn: 你们收现金吗？我今天只带了现金。

followUps.text: Can I pay half now and the rest next week? I'm waiting for my reimbursement.
followUps.text_cn: 我可以现在付一半，剩下部分下周再付吗？我在等报销款。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于结账环节，顾客根据自身支付能力选择支付方式，服务员通常会接受常见选项。

qaPairs.triggerText: The basic lenses are $120, but if you want anti-glare or blue light protection, it's an extra $60. Do you want those features?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 基础镜片是120美元，但如果您想要防眩光或防蓝光功能，需额外60美元。您需要这些功能吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 确认镜片升级选项及附加费用

followUps.text: Yes, I work on a computer all day—definitely add the blue light filter.
followUps.text_cn: 要的，我整天用电脑，一定要加防蓝光功能。

followUps.text: I'll stick with the basic ones—I'm on a tight budget this month.
followUps.text_cn: 我还是选基础款吧，这个月预算紧张。

followUps.text: Can you tell me how much longer the blue light coating lasts? I'm not sure it's worth it.
followUps.text_cn: 能告诉我防蓝光涂层能用多久吗？我不确定值不值。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客常在此环节因价格犹豫，需自然表达需求、预算或寻求信息。

qaPairs.triggerText: Just to confirm, you're happy with the price and the frame style? No changes?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我再确认一下，您对价格和镜框款式都满意吗？不需要更改了吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 最终确认价格与款式无异议

followUps.text: Yes, perfect—I'll take it.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，很好，我就要这个了。

followUps.text: Actually, can I see the silver frame again? I'm not sure this one suits me.
followUps.text_cn: 其实，我能再看看银色的那副吗？我不确定这副适合我。

followUps.text: Is there any discount if I buy two pairs? My sister needs glasses too.
followUps.text_cn: 如果我买两副，有折扣吗？我妹妹也需要配眼镜。

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是结账前的关键确认点，顾客可能确认、反悔或提出附加请求，需灵活应对。

subScenes.name: 取货时间
subScenes.description: 顾客确认配镜完成时间及取货流程。

qaPairs.triggerText: When would you like to pick up your glasses?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您想什么时候来取眼镜？

followUps.text: I can pick them up tomorrow afternoon.
followUps.text_cn: 我明天下午来取。

followUps.text: Can I pick them up next week? I'm traveling this weekend.
followUps.text_cn: 我这周末要旅行，能下周来取吗？

followUps.text: Are they ready yet? I thought it would be ready today.
followUps.text_cn: 眼镜已经做好了吗？我以为今天就能取。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于确认取货时间，常见于店员主动询问用户方便的时间点。

qaPairs.triggerText: Your glasses will be ready in two business days. Does that work for you?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您的眼镜两个工作日内可以准备好，这样可以吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 眼镜店告知取货时间并确认用户接受

followUps.text: Yes, that’s perfect. I’ll come on Wednesday.
followUps.text_cn: 好的，太完美了，我周三来取。

followUps.text: Is it possible to get them by tomorrow? I have an important meeting.
followUps.text_cn: 能明天拿到吗？我有个重要会议。

followUps.text: Actually, I’m not sure—I’ll call you if my schedule changes.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我还不确定，如果时间有变我再打电话给您。

qaPairs.usageNote: 店员告知预计完成时间后，用户可能接受、请求提前或表示不确定。

qaPairs.triggerText: We finished your glasses earlier than expected. Can you come in today?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您的眼镜比预期提前做好了，今天能来取吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 眼镜店通知提前完成，询问是否可立即取货

followUps.text: Really? That’s great! I’ll stop by after work.
followUps.text_cn: 真的吗？太好了！我下班后就来取。

followUps.text: I’m sorry, but I can’t make it today—I’m out of town.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，我今天不在城里，没法来取。

followUps.text: Can I send someone else to pick them up? I’ll give them the receipt.
followUps.text_cn: 我可以让人代取吗？我会把取货单给他们。

qaPairs.usageNote: 店员通知提前完成时，用户可能欣然接受、婉拒或提出代取方案。
